title: IPU documents on a crash that killed Sandia technicians

tellings.quote: IPU documents later because that actually talks about like a crash retrieval um that killed technicians at Sandia National Labs because of the danger of the crash.

plain: A set of papers called the IPU documents, said to come from a secret unit that recovered crashed craft, describe a crash retrieval in the late 1940s that killed technicians from Sandia National Labs, a US government weapons laboratory in New Mexico, because the wreck was so dangerous. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb mentions this in passing without naming a source, linking it to the Majestic documents, a disputed set of papers about a secret UFO group. If true, it would mean people died handling a crashed craft that the government kept secret.
